one_liner: We help a specific customer segment solve 'Manejo contable 100% automático para microempresas' through a focused software/AI workflow.

problem.who_suffers: Define one specific user and one economic buyer. Avoid broad labels like 'everyone' or 'companies'.
problem.pain_level: Quantify hours lost, money lost, risk, errors, or missed revenue per month.
problem.current_workaround: Identify the real competitor: spreadsheet, WhatsApp, email, manual labor, incumbent, or doing nothing.
problem.evidence_needed: At least 5 interviews, screenshots, public data, or workflow artifacts.

solution_insight.solution: A narrow workflow that produces an outcome the buyer already values.
solution_insight.insight: The likely insight is not 'AI can do it'; it is that a repeated expert workflow can be compressed and standardized.
solution_insight.non_stack_note: This dossier intentionally avoids frontend/backend stack because the correct stack changes by idea.

why_now: LLMs and agents can now execute and explain multi-step workflows cheaply.
Distribution through communities, outbound, and self-serve demos is faster for solo founders.
Users are more willing to try AI-native tools when the workflow is narrow and auditable.

market.recommended_focus: Start where the founder has fastest access to users and evidence; compare Peru, LATAM, and USA before committing.

regions.validity: Potentially strong for problems with local regulation, Spanish workflows, public data, or underserved SMEs.
regions.tam: Estimate from national population, firms, households, sector output, or public expenditure.
regions.sam: Start with reachable cities, industries, institutions, or customer segments where the founder can sell.
regions.som_12_months: Use a bottom-up estimate: reachable leads x conversion rate x annual contract value.

regions.validity: Attractive if the problem repeats across Spanish-speaking markets and does not require heavy country-by-country integration.
regions.tam: Estimate from regional sector size, number of firms, workers, students, patients, transactions, or institutions.
regions.sam: Prioritize countries with similar language, regulation, distribution, and payment behavior.
regions.som_12_months: Estimate expansion only after proving one repeatable channel in the first country.

regions.validity: Useful benchmark for market size and competitor density; attractive if willingness to pay is higher and distribution is reachable.
regions.tam: Estimate from US sector spend, number of businesses, paid seats, transactions, or workflow volume.
regions.sam: Narrow to a buyer segment the founder can actually reach through outbound, communities, or integrations.
regions.som_12_months: Use a conservative founder-led sales or self-serve acquisition model.

source_strategy: Use INEI microdata for Peru when the market depends on households, employment, education, health, agriculture, firms, or municipalities.
Use MEF/BCRP for public budgets, macro indicators, credit, sector output, and Peru-specific economic framing.
Use World Bank/CEPAL/IDB for LATAM comparables.
Use papers and industry reports when the market is technical, clinical, educational, or scientific.
Use bottom-up SOM for the first 12 months; do not rely only on top-down TAM.

competition_moat.weak_moat_warning: If Claude/OpenAI can solve the job with a prompt, the startup needs a workflow, data, distribution, or compliance layer.

business_model_pricing.pricing_rule: Use no more than 3 plans and tie price to a buyer-visible outcome.
business_model_pricing.contribution_margin: Estimate tokens/API calls, storage, human review, support, and acquisition cost per customer.

go_to_market.first_10: Founder-led outreach to people with the exact painful workflow.
go_to_market.first_100: Repeat the channel that produced the first paid or high-intent users.
go_to_market.first_1000: Add scalable distribution: partnerships, integrations, content, community, marketplace, or PLG.

traction_signals: letters of intent or paid pilots

roadmap.3_months: Validate the wedge, ship concierge/prototype workflow, close first paying or high-intent users.
roadmap.6_months: Productize repeated steps, measure retention, build first repeatable acquisition channel.
roadmap.12_months: Expand to adjacent workflow or geography after proving retention and willingness to pay.

risks_mitigations.risk: Market risk: users like the idea but do not have urgent pain.
risks_mitigations.mitigation: Interview around recent behavior and require evidence of money/time/risk.

risks_mitigations.risk: AI substitution risk: Claude, OpenAI, or another foundation-model tool absorbs the feature.
risks_mitigations.mitigation: Own workflow data, distribution, integrations, evaluation harnesses, and domain trust beyond the prompt.

risks_mitigations.risk: Execution risk: solo founder overbuilds before validation.
risks_mitigations.mitigation: Run concierge tests and kill criteria before building broad product surface area.

the_ask.amount: Define a specific amount or resource ask only after the first validation sprint.
the_ask.milestone: Unlock proof that one segment has repeated pain and will pay for the outcome.

product_demo_architecture.demo_credentials: TODO: add test user credentials once demo is live
main_flow_screenshots: 2. Core input form or conversation entry
product_demo_architecture.architecture_diagram: Frontend (web/mobile) → API layer (FastAPI / Flask) → Orchestration (agent loop) → LLM API + domain data sources → Database (Postgres / SQLite) → Output / report
ai_models_used: deepseek-chat — fast, cheap inference for classification and structured extraction
deepseek-reasoner — multi-step reasoning for validation and scoring

scorecard.note: Promising only after 5 concrete user interviews prove recent painful behavior.
Insight needs sharper wording around what existing alternatives miss.
Market sizing is not yet evidenced; compare Peru, LATAM, and USA before choosing focus.
Moat is weak until workflow data, distribution, or community compounds.
Pricing needs a concrete buyer metric and contribution margin assumptions.
First 10 users can be founder-led; first 100 and 1,000 need a repeatable channel.
No traction provided in the input; require interviews, waitlist, pilots, or usage.
A 3/6/12 month roadmap is feasible if the first wedge is narrow.
AI-platform substitution and weak demand are the main risks to control.

external_research_hooks.inei_microdatos: Useful for Peru-specific TAM/SAM evidence from INEI surveys and variable search.
external_research_hooks.paperdl: Useful for finding academic papers when the idea needs scientific, health, education, or technical evidence.

fatal_flaws.risk: Market risk: users like the idea but don't have urgent pain.
fatal_flaws.why_it_matters: No urgency = no switching from free alternatives.
fatal_flaws.fast_test: 5 interviews asking about last time this pain cost them time or money.

fatal_flaws.risk: Payment blocker: buyer can't pay via SaaS subscription given Peru's informal economy.
fatal_flaws.why_it_matters: No recurring billing = no SaaS business model.
fatal_flaws.fast_test: Ask 3 target buyers if they have a credit card or Yape for business payments.

fatal_flaws.risk: Free substitute absorbs 80% of use case before product ships.
fatal_flaws.why_it_matters: WhatsApp + Excel + Google Forms are entrenched and free.
fatal_flaws.fast_test: Map every step of the workflow to existing free tools; identify the gap.

first_10_customers.action: Send 20 WhatsApp voice messages to target buyers with a 2-sentence problem statement.
first_10_customers.how_to_reach: Use LinkedIn to find names, then WhatsApp via shared group or mutual contact.

first_10_customers.action: Run a 30-min Zoom demo for 5 warm contacts who already have this pain.
first_10_customers.target_persona: Operators who currently use the manual workaround
first_10_customers.how_to_reach: Search LinkedIn for job title + pain keyword, send a connection note referencing the exact problem.

first_10_customers.action: Attend one industry event or WhatsApp group where target buyers gather.
first_10_customers.target_persona: Any buyer who attends sector events or online communities
first_10_customers.how_to_reach: Join the WhatsApp group, post a pain-question (not a pitch), DM respondents.

mvp_2_week_test.build: A single-workflow prototype: one input, one output — no dashboard, no settings.
mvp_2_week_test.cut: Authentication, billing, multi-user, reporting, and any feature beyond the core workflow.
mvp_2_week_test.test_hypothesis: If 3 of 5 demo users complete the workflow without help and ask 'when can I use this?', demand is real.
mvp_2_week_test.success_signal: At least 1 user offers to pay or signs a letter of intent within 2 weeks.
